findings.description: The operator-role set does not pin the user-promised auditor role, even though the contract's easy UX explicitly includes 'Codex auditor' as a first-class configuration example.
findings.recommendation: Add auditor to OPERATOR_ROLES or define auditor as a documented canonical alias with tests proving it stores and renders distinctly.

findings.description: Operator-role values span both operator surfaces and agent runtimes, but the plan does not pin the value domain or disambiguation model for inputs like Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and Antigravity.
findings.recommendation: Define whether operator_roles values are a tagged union of runtime and surface ids, then pin alias collision handling and dashboard/dispatch interpretation.

findings.description: F002 only requires a generic TERM_PROGRAM operator-surface heuristic, so the plan does not prove deterministic detection for each named invocation surface in the journey.
findings.recommendation: Pin a named heuristic table cell for terminal, cursor, claude_desktop, codex_app, antigravity, remote_vm, and github_vm, or explicitly document which are explicit-env only.

findings.description: The resolver test list covers unrecognized explicit operator, role, and locality values, but omits the required unknown-agent path for DONT_PANIC_AGENT to unknown_runtime.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit DONT_PANIC_AGENT garbage-value test asserting normalize_identifier maps it to unknown_runtime without rejection or guessing.

findings.description: The plan says DONT_PANIC_ROLE maps unrecognized values to an unknown member, but F001 also says the role axis reuses existing ROLES without pinning an unknown_role canonical value.
findings.recommendation: Pin the worker-role canonical set for InvocationContext, including unknown_role or an equivalent explicit fallback, before relying on role normalization.

findings.description: F001 defines recognized operator surfaces that F008 intentionally does not seed, but F007 only specifies unknown-surface failure and not recognized-but-unmanifested doctor behavior.
findings.recommendation: Specify that doctor --channel for a recognized surface lacking an operator_surface manifest exits non-zero with an actionable missing-manifest message.

findings.description: F009 says the producer derives only from ledger, capabilities, worktree bindings, and operator_roles, while the same acceptance requires dispatchability from capabilities plus AGENT_REGISTRY.
findings.recommendation: Include AGENT_REGISTRY as an explicit allowed producer input, or define a capability snapshot that is proven to be derived from AGENT_REGISTRY.

findings.description: The locked rule matrix pins stale thresholds and conflict precedence, but does not fully pin criteria and precedence for remote_only, remote_cannot_mutate_local, unhealthy_worktree_binding, and operator_only_runtime_not_dispatchable.
findings.recommendation: Expand the locked bucket matrix to define every bucket's predicate, overlap behavior, active/stale interaction, and renderer expectations cell by cell.
